verdict: Local search interest is rising, but no leads are converting yet.
narrative: This period, all activity came through organic channels — paid advertising on Meta and Google was not running, so there is no ad spend or cost-per-lead to report. Your Google Business Profile had a strong week, with actions jumping 300% compared to the prior week and 53 total interactions over the last 28 days. Despite that interest — 33 requests for directions and 19 clicks to your website — no leads were recorded, pointing to a gap in the path between someone finding you and completing an inquiry. We're investigating the intake and contact flow to identify where that drop-off is happening and get it resolved.

highlights.phrase: Google Business Profile interactions in the last 28 days (directions, web clicks, and calls)
week-over-week spike in Google Business Profile activity this past week
website sessions recorded over the last 28 days

watch_item.issue: People are finding you via local search and clicking through, but none are completing an inquiry — the conversion path is not capturing this traffic.
watch_item.fix: We are auditing the contact and intake flow now to find and close the drop-off point before next week.
